nurse.text: Welcome to Sligo Sanctuary. 'Cast a cold eye on life, on death.' That's Yeats' grave, not our policy. We'll have you warm in no time.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit down, I'll fetch the poultice. It's mostly tea, but it works.
There you go. 'Go n-éirí an bóthar leat', may the road rise with you. And may the wind stay at your back.
The Ark terminal's in the corner. Treat it gently, it reads poetry to the creatures.

else.text: No hurry at all. Benbulben's not going anywhere, and neither's the kettle.
